svg.text: 960,000 = 4,800 × 200, so ÷4 then ÷5 gives exactly 10 samples per symbol. 648 Hz reads as 1.0, so the four tones read ±1 and ±3.
(b) RRC at both ends = a raised-cosine pulse
Zero at all the other symbol centres: neighbours add nothing (no ISI).
(c) x[n] for 14 symbols; dots = symbol centres
Pick the right sample in each 10 and you read ±1 / ±3 exactly.
